scale: unfiltered current training labels population standard deviation; ddof=0
top1_selection: smallest prediction; exact ties broken by ascending candidate_id
top1_regret: actual value of selected record minus minimum actual value in current validation/test set
aggregation: arithmetic mean of 10 outer-fold scores; inner selection uses mean of 3 inner-fold scores
undefined_fold_rule: stop ranking; never silently discard or impute a fold
low_training_weight: xgb_weighted only: fit labels <=132.80 weight 8; other labels weight 1
interpretation: Internal known-dataset benchmark; finite held-out candidate selection, not new-W optimization
